notes.title: Our Biggest Update Yet! Welcome to the new Holodrive!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12524389/b8aad34bffd226b25a84ac97912e5c699623f9d4.png

Hello to all proud Dummy owners!

We've been working on this MASSIVE change to the game since October last year and we've been releasing bits and pieces of all the changes on social media, but today is finally the day!

Welcome to the new Holodrive gameplay experience!

Holodrive is not the same anymore, we've revised core gameplay mechanics such as Power Ups, Health Pickups, Weapon Pickups, Ammo, Jetpack... And we changed ALL OF THEM!

Here's what you will find in this new experience:


- New Mechanic: Main Weapon
Players can only have 1 weapon in their arsenal at a time (before this update players could have up to 7 weapons in their arsenal), but you can freely change it by Pressing R when you die. Or you can steal your enemies gun by Pressing R when on top of their dropped weapon ;)

- New Mechanic: Devices
https://i.imgur.com/oMmDdgy.gif
Devices are new grenade-like objects that are super situational and have a bunch of different effects! Right now you can only use Electrify (which shocks nearby enemies causing 50 damage) or the Disarm Device (which makes your enemies unable to fire weapons for a bit of time). Mastering the new Devices mechanics is key to becoming the best Holodrive player!

- New Mechanic: Super Weapons
https://i.imgur.com/xMvnaO7.gif
Super Weapons are extremely powerfull weapons that you can use sparingly during the course of a match! To unlock your Super Weapon you need to fill the Super Gauge at the top left corner of the screen, when its full you unleash your Super Weapon by pressing E on the Keyboard! Beware! It only lasts for a bit of time! - When you unleash your Super your Energy is also refilled! Use it wisely -

- New Mechanic: Health Regeneration
https://i.imgur.com/Z1stsje.gif
After a while your health will regenerate now! No more health pickups and the frustration of your enemy using a health pickup and filling up 100% of their health!

- New Mechanic: Energy
https://i.imgur.com/C52jRXa.gif
Energy is your primary resource, and it auto-refills super quick! Gone are the days of picking up weapons in the map to refill your ammo! Now both your Jetpack and your Ammo uses the Energy resource, so take care! Resource management is your primary concern!

- New Weapon Unlock progression system (players can now purchase any weapon directly with bits!)
- New/Improved Particle Effects:
  - Player on fire (flamethrower damage over time)
  - Explosions
  - Respawn
- New Tutorial - Remade from scratch to reflect the new mechanics

- Weapons do not have stacking ammo clips anymore
- Removed Weapon Pickups from the game
- Removed Power-ups from the game
- Removed Health pickups from the game
- Players can now change weapons at any time while they are inside their base
- You can freely change your Weapon, Device and Ultimate while in a match


- Added German to the game! (Set your Steam to German, the game detects automagically)
  - Thanks to community member R I L E Y on our Discord!
- Revised and Spellchecked French!
  - Thanks to community member NodeuSFlatcher on our Discord!

Want to become a translator and help us? Join our discord.gg/Holodrive and talk to [Dev]Ashkental !

Gameplay Balancing

- Health now regenerates after 4 seconds of not taking damage
Weapons

Basic Weapon

- Removed from the game

Plasma Gun

- Ammo count increased from 60 to 80
- Max damage reduced from 12 to 10
- Heat Charge time increased from 1.5 to 2
- Heat Decay time decreased from 1 to 0.5

Shotgun

- Ammo count increased from 12 to 18

Raygun
Changed how ammo works for Continuous weapons, instead of seconds it’s now a value, like the other weapons.

- Ammo changed from 5 seconds to 84 (It now takes 6 seconds to deplete ammo)

Grenade Launcher

- Ammo count increased from 12 to 18
- Shoot force reduced from 75 to 70
- Fire rate reduced from 1.4 to 1.3
- Explosion minimum damage radius reduced from 12 to 8
- Explosion medium damage radius reduced from 8.5 to 6
- Explosion max damage radius increased from 3.5 to 4

Grenade Bullet
Physics

- Drag increased from 0 to 0.5
- Dynamic friction increased from 0.6 to 0.8
- Bounciness reduced from 0.2 to 0.075
- Friction combine reduced from 3 to 0
- Bounce combine reduced from 3 to 0

These changes makes the grenade less bouncy and travel less after touching the floor overall

Minigun

- Ammo count reduced from 200 to 150

Shuriken Launcher

- Damage increased from 40 to 50
- Fire rate increased from 1.1 to 1.3
- Ammo count kept at 8

Shuriken Bullet

- Shuriken bullet now auto-explodes after it travels 60 units.
- Explosions range of damage reduced from 3 to 2
  - Max damage deals 50 damage and has a 5 radius range
  - Min damage deals 25 damage and has a 6.5 radius range
- Total damage radius reduced from 10 to 6.5
  - Damage radius better reflects the activation area (it was a lot bigger before)
- Time until auto-activation reduced from 6 to 4 seconds

Sniper

- Charge time reduced from 2.2 to 2 seconds
- Ammo count reduced from 5 to 4

Flamethrower
Changed how ammo works for Continuous weapons, instead of seconds it’s now a value, like the other weapons.

- Ammo changed from 5 seconds to 60 (It now takes 6 seconds to deplete ammo)
- Reduced Damage Over Time from 24 over 3.24s to 18 over 1.5s
- Increased fire rate from 10 to 11

Brave Heart
Changed how ammo works for Continuous weapons, instead of seconds it’s now a value, like the other weapons.

- Ammo changed from 5 seconds to 90 (It now takes 6 seconds to deplete ammo)
- Fire Rate reduced from 15 to 14
- Max damage increased from 15 to 18 (at 30 or less health)

Intimidator

- Fire Rate increased from 11 to 14
- Ammo count reduced from 70 to 60

Bow

- Ammo count increased from 5 to 8

Plutonium Gun

- Ammo count increased from 14 to 16

Bazooka

- Bazooka is now a Super Weapon
- Super Weapons are time-based and have infinite ammo
- Damage increased from 75 to 100
- Fire Rate decreased from 1.1 to 0.85
- Bazooka duration is 5 seconds
- Reduced damage areas slightly

Scattergun

- Scattergun is now a Super Weapon
- Super Weapons are time-based and have infinite ammo
- Bullet Damage increased from 6 to 20
- Frag Bullet damage increased from 8 to 12
- Fire Rate increased from 1.1 to 1.2
- Scattergun duration is 5 seconds

The Dematerializer

- The Dematerializer is now a Super Weapon
- Super Weapons are time-based and have infinite ammo
- Removed charge time
- Added Fire Rate of 1.1
- The Dematerializer duration is 5 seconds
  - If a player misses a shot the Super ends immediately

Phantomzooka

- Phantomzookais now a Super Weapon
- Super Weapons are time-based and have infinite ammo
- Initial travel speed increased from 65 to 85
- Wall speed slow decreased from 70% to 40% (goes through walls faster)
- Out of wall speed slow decreased from 5% to 0% (it comes out the same speed as it went in)
- Fire Rate increased from 1 to 1.3
- Phantomzooka duration is 5 seconds


Bugfixes
- Fixed a bug where explosions could cause 0 damage
- Fixed a small Jetpack recharge inconsistency which resulted into the energy recharging faster than it was supposed to sometimes.


Come and try out all the new changes! We think you'll enjoy it ;)

As always we're open to your feedbacks so join our Discord.gg/Holodrive and com talk to us! (We don't bite, promise). 


Thank you all!


BitCake Studio Development Team

notes.title: Server issues fix and an update on our next Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Over the weekend we received a bunch of reports from you guys about some servers issues you were having (on US servers mainly). I'd like to tell you that we've identified and already fixed the issue.

This happened on our side, so there was no need for any game files update. We also took the time to strengthen our servers on both US and EU and make matchmaking a bit more reliable :)


Also, we've been working really really hard on our next major update, it's going to take a bit more time to ship it than we previously thought, but it's going to fundamentally change how you play the game. There are some new mechanics coming and some old mechanics being retired. We can't wait to show you all more next year!

Have fun! :D

notes.title: Changes are coming! Read here ;)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re here today to talk to you about some changes that we’re planning for Holodrive, these changes are not something minor like adding a new weapon or power-ups, but are major changes that may shake the very core of how the game is played.

We have been developing this game for quite a while and everyone that has been following us knows that we’re pretty open when it comes to the development of the game. We love talking to you guys and gathering feedback, we make videos of prototypes that we’re developing and we were never shy about changing or removing features from the game.

Learning and evolving is part of the process and the team has been thinking a lot on many of your feedbacks in regards to weapons and gameplay. Feedbacks that range from the game being very random because of power-ups, to very frustrating because of Health Pickups. Not only that but we thought a lot about Holodrive’s core mechanic: of having 7 weapons, a basic weapon, having weapon pickups on the map and all that. We decided that we need to be better, we need to evolve Holodrive’s gameplay to be something more engaging and more deep, we want everyone to be able to pick up the game and play but realize that there’s more depth to it than it seems.

On this post we’re going to outline the Core Mechanics that we feel are in need of a second look, we won’t get into specifics now. We will do that in future posts.

These are the mechanics that we’re considering changes:

- 7 Weapons Loadout
- Basic Weapon
- Weapons Categories
- Pickups in the map
- Health pickups
- Ammo system

The systems outlined above could see changes that could range from major to minor (we could also not change a system at all), but the end result should be a vastly different game than what you guys play today.

So you may be asking when will the changes come? Well, they are still in prototype phase so we don’t have any date for you yet. We have lots of stuff to test, and we want your help in doing it! As of right now we’ll be creating a special Community Role called “Super Tester". These special players will receive access to every change before anyone else in order to help us test them before they are officially unveiled to the rest of the community!

Our first test is going to be tomorrow!

Wanna become a super tester? Join our discord @ Discord.gg/Holodrive and talk to the Devs or Mods! We have open spots ;)

Best Regards,

BitCake Studio Dev Team

notes.title: Economy Update is Live! (Please Read!)
notes.content:
Hey guys and gals!

As we've explained in the previous update we were going to overhaul the entire Economy of the game by changing many of the prices and values and costs related to Holopacks, Bits and Crafting.

With that said the changes are now live and here's the main changes:

- You will receive a Rare Holopack for logging 7 days now!
- Rare Holopacks now have an overall better chance of dropping Rare or better customizations. (better than regular Holopack)
- Epic Holopacks now drop 5 items instead of 4 with 1 guaranteed rare, 1 guaranteed epic.
- Epic Holopacks now have an overall better chance of dropping rare or better customizations. (better than the Rare Holopack)

Holopack Pricing Changes:

- Regular Holopacks pricing will increase from 100 to 240 Bits
- Rare Holopacks pricing will increase from 150 to 650 Bits
- Epic Holopacks pricing will increase from 300 to 1200 Bits

Bits Pack Changes:

- 4,99 Bits Pack will increase from 500 to 1200 Bits
- 9,99 Bits Pack will increase from 1100 to 2640 Bits
- 19,99 Bits Pack will increase from 2300 to 5520 Bits
- 39,99 Bits Pack will increase from 5000 to 11520 Bits

Store Pricing Changes:

- The Hero new fixed price from 9,99 to 2,99
- Founder's Pack and Early Access pack were also updated the reflect the new Bits values

Crafting Changes:

DeMaterialization rewards:

- Common = 5 Quarks
- Rare = 20 Quarks
- Epic = 100 Quarks
- Legendary = 400 Quarks
- Foil Common = 40 Quarks
- Foil Rare = 100 Quarks
- Foil Epic = 400 Quarks
- Foil Legendary = 1600 Quarks

New Crafting values:

- Victory Poses are now craftable!
- Regular items have had their crafting costs changed.
- Victory Poses have their own Quark costs.
- Sets and Foil items now have their own Quark costs.
- Crafting Sets and Foils now requires more Quarks.

And as always you can find the entire development team on our Official Discord, please come and send us your feedback @ discord.gg/holodrive

BitCake Dev Team

notes.title: Holodrive's First Update! (Resolutions quickfix)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've been listening to you all and we just released a new update with some changes and fixes:

 We unlocked custom resolutions (this is a quickfix before we natively support 4:3 monitors and other crazy resolutions)*
 Now everyone starts with all the weapons unlocked!
 Now you'll get a Holopack from the tutorial instead of a Legacypack
 Players from level 1-9 will have a different map playlist. We've removed Floorophobic, Jipe and Hexa because these maps were really big and very hard to find eachother.
 Bugfixes

*In order to have a custom resolution you'll need to right click Holodrive in your library and click properties and "Set Launch Options" and write:
-screen-fullscreen 0 -screen-width 1600 -screen-height 900

Please note that we only support 16:9 resolutions, so please use any of these custom resolutions to play the game: 1024×576, 1152×648, 1280×720, 1366×768, 1600×900, 1920×1080, 2560×1440 and 3840×2160. Support for 4:3 monitors will come in the future.


See you all in-game! :D

- A new game mode
- Rebalance our economy based on your feedback


This is it folks, we'll definitely see you in game!


The BitCake Studio team
